page_title: RBL 5-1 STU | RB Leipzig v Stuttgart 25/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+5' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart) sends the corner into the box, but Janis Blaswich intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+4' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+3' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+3' Alexander Nubel was forced into action to thwart Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
90+1' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Chris Fuhrich and he is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch so that Woo-Yeong Jeong can be given a rest.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
88' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
85' Substitution. Dani Olmo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
85' Here's the change. Mohamed Simakan leaves the pitch and Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Yussuf Poulsen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Xavi Simons is replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).
79' The substitution is prepared. Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lois Openda.
76' 5 - 1 Goal! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:1.

76' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
74' 4 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Alexander Nubel. He makes it 4:1.
73' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
72' A rebound falls at the feet of Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
70' Here is a change. Pascal Stenzel is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Roberto Massimo (VfB Stuttgart).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Genki Haraguchi (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Lilian Egloff.

66' 3 - 1 David Raum sends a superb cross into the box. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top right corner, leaving Alexander Nubel beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:1.
65' Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Xavi Simons plays a short, square pass into the path of Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 2:1. Fabulous goal!
62' The attendance for today's match is 46084.
61' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is punished with the yellow card.
61' The game is interrupted now, Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' Substitution. Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Silas walks off.
55' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The RB Leipzig players look gutted.
54' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The RB Leipzig players aren’t happy.
53' Goal 2:1! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexander Nubel makes a huge mistake and Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
50' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for RB Leipzig! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Frank Willenborg and both teams have no complaints.
48' Referee Frank Willenborg makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
47' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from RB Leipzig for a penalty. Play continues.

47' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the target, but Alexander Nubel keeps the ball out. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' Referee Frank Willenborg halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Rose, then shows him a yellow.
45+7' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

45+6' Play continues despite the shouts by some RB Leipzig players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Frank Willenborg interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+4' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
45+3' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
45+2' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
41' Stuttgart hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

35' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
35' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Chris Fuhrich, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
34' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Alexander Nubel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
33' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.

28' Dani Olmo sprays a wonderful pass out to Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Alexander Nubel problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
26' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
23' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:2. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
17' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but Alexander Nubel punches the ball away.
13' The resulting corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
11' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.
7' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

7' A snap shot by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Janis Blaswich produces a good save to thwart him. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
5' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
4' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul. RB Leipzig are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
3' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
3' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
1' The first half has started.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Frank Willenborg was nominated as the referee for this game.
